actual_loader_chain.fact: Actual device registration pairs contain key4→0x212fe0 and key26→0x217488. Registration loop copies function pointers to indexed device slots. This locates the actual native creation and PS2 stream reader, independently of library names.
Reader checks native PS2 magic0x00325350, reads names/STRUCT, calls raster reader0x217050. Supported RW version interval and native version2 match both pinned members.

Reads0x40-byte native record; copies TEX0 low/high to extension+8/+0xc, paletteOffset field+0x18 to extension+0x10, TEX1LOW to extension+0x16, size fields to+0x28/+0x2c/+0x30. Therefore later CBP relocation uses the serialized paletteOffset64.

Version2 reads pixelSize bytes directly to the created pixel-packet buffer and paletteSize bytes to palettePointer-0x50. No palette-color or index transformation occurs between these stream reads and the modern packet upload route.
No-mip creation uses native page geometry, bufferBase0, bufferWidth2, paletteOffset64 and6144-word footprint for128x128/8bit. Native values agree with both members and existing exact footprint guard.

PSMT8/CPSM0, final TBW2 takes source-specific palette-coordinate branch. Actual block permutation/subtraction gives adjustedPalette64, X0, Y64, packedTRXPOS0x0040000000000000. It is not an asset-name case.

PSMT8 swizzled upload uses bufferWidth2 halved to DBW1, DPSM0/PSMCT32, relative DBP0. Nonzero palette position copies the existing pixel BITBLTBUF quadword (LQ at0x21467c, SQ at0x21468c), reduces transfer count and extends the prior DMAref/DIRECT counts. Pixel and CLUT headers/payloads remain one contiguous1098-qword stream.

Modern uploader receives VRAM base in32bit words. Aligns it to64word boundary and adds (baseWords>>6)<<32 to copied BITBLTBUF; LQ/SQ preserve other transfer fields, PCPYLD preserves GS register address0x50. For one merged transfer, DMAref payload is reused verbatim.

Default cache residency record provides that same baseWords. Sampled TEX0.TBP0=(baseWords>>6)&0x3fff; TEX0.CBP=((baseWords>>6)+extension.paletteOffset)&0x3fff. Updated TEX0 is emitted with GS register6/7. Thus sampled CBP is uploadBaseBlocks+64, not serialized zero.
Second normal residency path passes record.baseWords into0x2270b0 then writes TBP0/CBP using the same record and extension.paletteOffset. Independent corroboration within the actual game binary.
